COVERED_ZONE.TITLE: Covered Zones
COVERED_ZONE.SUBTITLE: Define radius-based delivery zones around each branch, set how far pickup orders can come from, and pin every branch's exact location on the map.

BRANCH_LOCATIONS.TITLE: Branch locations
BRANCH_LOCATIONS.SUBTITLE: Pin each branch on the map. Zones below are measured as concentric radii around these pins.
BRANCH_LOCATIONS.MISSING_HINT: Required before pickup orders or zone-based delivery can work for this branch.

PICKUP.TITLE: Pickup max distance
PICKUP.SUBTITLE: Maximum distance (km) we'll accept pickup orders from. Set to 0 to allow pickup from anywhere.
PICKUP.LABEL: Distance (km)
PICKUP.ERR_NEED_PINS: Pickup max distance can't be greater than 0 until every branch above has a pinned location.

BULK.TITLE: Bulk update zones
BULK.SUBTITLE: Apply the same delivery economics to every zone in one click.
BULK.NO_FIELDS: Fill at least one field to apply.
BULK.CONFIRM_BODY: Apply the filled fields to all {{count}} zone(s)? Existing values will be overwritten.

ZONES.TITLE: Zones
ZONES.SUBTITLE: Each zone is a concentric ring around the pinned branch locations. Closer rings should have a smaller radius.
ZONES.EMPTY: No zones yet — click Add zone to create the first one.
ZONES.ERR_RADIUS_REQ: Radius must be greater than zero.
ZONES.ERR_RADIUS_DUP: Two zones share the same radius. Make them unique.

COVERED_ZONE.MAP_HINT: Concentric rings show each zone's radius around every branch with a pinned location.
COVERED_ZONE.MAP_NO_PINS: No branches have pinned locations yet — pin at least one above to see the zones drawn here.
